format: stands/15-scenarios (A4 modal: a page, probes in steps); the runner is tests/browser/manifest-probes.browser.mjs

probes.title: the value given is cleaned: attributes, script and a javascript: link go, b is strong, loose text is a paragraph
the editing surface is a multiline textbox named by the label and described by the hint; the toolbar is one Tab stop

steps.check: (() => { const e = document.querySelector('#r1 .sf-rich-text-editor'); const label = document.getElementById(e.getAttribute('aria-labelledby')); const hint = document.getElementById(e.getAttribute('aria-describedby')); const bar = document.querySelector('#r1 [role=toolbar]'); const tools = [...bar.querySelectorAll('button.sf-rich-text-tool')]; return e.getAttribute('role') === 'textbox' && e.getAttribute('aria-multiline') === 'true' && e.isContentEditable && label.textContent.trim() === 'Page text' && hint.textContent.trim() === 'Formatted text' && bar.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Formatting' && bar.getAttribute('aria-controls') === e.id && tools.length === 12 && tools.filter((t) => t.tabIndex === 0).length === 1; })()

probes.title: the form sends the cleaned HTML under name
a command on the selection: a bulleted list, said with one input

steps.script: (() => { const el = document.getElementById('r1'); window.__inputs = 0; el.addEventListener('input', () => { window.__inputs += 1; }); const e = el.querySelector('.sf-rich-text-editor'); e.focus(); const r = document.createRange(); r.selectNodeContents(e.querySelector('p')); getSelection().removeAllRanges(); getSelection().addRange(r); return el.runCommand('bulleted-list'); })()

probes.title: a value set from code is cleaned and says nothing

steps.script:
(() => { const el = document.getElementById('r1'); window.__said = 0; el.addEventListener('input', () => { window.__said += 1; }); el.addEventListener('change', () => { window.__said += 1; }); el.value = '

Title

Text x y

'; return true; })()

probes.title: a form reset puts the value attribute back after an edit, and says nothing

steps.script: (() => { const el = document.getElementById('r1'); const e = el.querySelector('.sf-rich-text-editor'); e.focus(); const r = document.createRange(); r.selectNodeContents(e.querySelector('p')); getSelection().removeAllRanges(); getSelection().addRange(r); el.runCommand('quote'); return true; })()

(() => { const el = document.getElementById('r1'); window.__said = 0; el.addEventListener('input', () => { window.__said += 1; }); el.addEventListener('change', () => { window.__said += 1; }); document.getElementById('f').reset(); return true; })()

probes.title: required and empty: value-missing, the form does not validate; text makes it valid

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.getElementById('r2'); return el.value === '' && el.validity.valueMissing === true && document.getElementById('f').checkValidity() === false && el.querySelector('.sf-rich-text-editor').getAttribute('aria-required') === 'true'; })()

probes.title: disabled: not editable, not focusable, the toolbar disabled, not sent

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.getElementById('r3'); const e = el.querySelector('.sf-rich-text-editor'); return !e.isContentEditable && e.tabIndex === -1 && e.getAttribute('aria-disabled') === 'true' && [...el.querySelectorAll('button.sf-rich-text-tool')].every((b) => b.disabled) && !new FormData(document.getElementById('f')).has('off'); })()

probes.title: the toolbar's words follow the page language; the host's aria-label names the text

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.getElementById('r4'); const bar = el.querySelector('[role=toolbar]'); const e = el.querySelector('.sf-rich-text-editor'); return bar.getAttribute('aria-label') !== 'Formatting' && bar.getAttribute('aria-label').length > 0 && e.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Text'; })()
